# MathJax 3.2.2

The `tex-svg.js` bundle is vendored from the source below. A short header comment describes its role; the bundled code is unchanged:

https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js

License: Apache-2.0, included in `LICENSE`.

Only base and AMS LaTeX packages are enabled. SVG output embeds its glyphs; no external fonts, CDN requests or extra extension downloads are required for MRILab's equations. The renderer loads on demand when the equation panel opens.

Documentation: https://docs.mathjax.org/en/v3.2/web/typeset.html
